newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-MIDDLESBROUGH CONFIRM TOTTENHAM BID FOR JUNINHO.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MIDDLESBROUGH CONFIRM TOTTENHAM BID FOR JUNINHO.

text.p: English premier league club Middlesbrough confirmed on Monday they had accepted an 11 million pounds ($18.3 million) bid from Tottenham for their Brazilian midfielder Juninho.
"We have accepted the bid from Tottenham and we have informed Juninho. It is now subject to him agreeing personal terms," said Dave Allen, Middlesbrough's public relations officer.
Allen dismissed reports that the Brazilian had already signed for Athletico Madrid.
"That is not true. At the moment Juninho is still a Middlesbrough player," he said.
"Athletico made an offer some weeks ago but it was derisory.
"Tottenham are the only club we have accepted an offer from and the way is clear for them to discuss terms with Juninho."
